narration.reasoning: The transaction is executed via the Safe's execTransaction (c0, c1), which verifies two signatures via ecrecover (c2, c3), increments the Safe's nonce from 1 to 2 (s2), and delegatecalls into MultiSendCallOnly v1.4.1 (c4). MultiSendCallOnly performs two CALL operations from the Safe: first, transferring 20 ETH (20000000000000000000 wei) to hot wallet (c5, b0, b1); second, calling USDC.transfer (c6, c7) to send 10,000 USDC (10000000000 base units) from the Safe to hot wallet (s0, s1, b2, b3, e1). Finally, ExecutionSuccess is emitted by the Safe (e0).

effects.sentence: Safe transfers 20 ETH to hot wallet via MultiSendCallOnly v1.4.1.
Safe transfers 10,000 USDC to hot wallet via MultiSendCallOnly v1.4.1.
Safe increments its transaction nonce from 1 to 2 and emits ExecutionSuccess.
